betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Every NewGunrizons weapon, part, magazine and round is made in the Munitions Factory, and nowhere else.

Controller: 2 LV circuits, LV Robot Arm, 2 LV Conveyors, LV Hull, 2 LV Pistons.
Assembly Frames: Assembler, 6 plates + 1 frame box of the tier's material + 1 circuit of the tier (or by hand: 6 plates, frame box, circuit, hammer and wrench).

[note]Layout (controller in the middle of the front face):[/note]
Head (slice 0), 3x3:
  C C C
  C [K] C
  C C C
Each segment behind it (slice 1, 2, 3...), 3x3:
  F F F   <- roof: 3 Assembly Frames of the segment's tier
  G . G   <- 2 glass, empty in the middle (the assembly lane)
  C C C   <- floor: Heat Proof Machine Casings
Back cap, right behind the last segment, 3x3:
  C C C
  C C C
  C C C
C = Heat Proof Machine Casing (hatches go here), K = controller. The smallest factory is 3x3x3.
Segment 1 is roofed with LV (Steel) frames, segment 2 with MV (Aluminium)... segment 14 with MAX (Magmatter). The GregTech Machine Casing of the same tier also works as roof.
The number of consecutive segments is the factory's era (highest recipe tier). Each segment adds 4 parallels.
Tip: hold a Hologram Projector with the stack size set to the number of segments.

Hatches: 1 Energy, 1 Maintenance, 1 Input Bus, 1 Output Bus (+ an Input Hatch for solder).
